coordinateFrame: Runtime x/z metres; north/upstage is negative z

campRelocation.rule: The approved camp moves as one unit. Preserve tent-to-fire relationships, fire clearance, and the open west arrival.

spatialZones.label: Audience meadow
spatialZones.purpose: Low grass and worn footfall arcs preserve the stage sightline and performer approach.

spatialZones.label: Fern + boulder screen
spatialZones.purpose: A rooted edge separates stage and camp without hiding the campfire glow.

spatialZones.label: Moss + deadwood screen
spatialZones.purpose: One decomposing habitat closes the old empty gap while leaving the spur open.

spatialZones.label: Sedge + firefly hollow
spatialZones.purpose: A low wet pocket gives the downstage-right clearing a distinct ecological cause.

route.label: Enter
route.read: The stage is centered beyond the audience meadow.

route.label: Arrive
route.read: The meadow opens and the campfire appears at the right edge.

route.label: Perform
route.read: The stage and its upstage tree frame own the clearing.

route.label: Branch
route.read: A curved spur passes between two habitat screens.

route.label: Camp
route.read: The campsite becomes a separate destination on a level shelf.

route.label: Leave
route.read: The northwest trail carries the view into forest depth.

verticalSection.axis: stage center to east camp pocket

approvalQuestion: Does the plan read as stage first, camp second, and forest depth third, with the campsite functioning as a separate destination?
